messages:
maria (Design): dropping a compact update to the keys modal. two quick design questions: 1) after rotate, do we keep the modal open so the user can copy the secret, or auto-return to the keys list? 2) revoke wording feels too technical for some customers. thoughts?

josh (Eng): keeping the modal open is easy. we can auto-select the revealed secret. downside: current flow routes to list on success, so tests need updating. also watch for SR re-announcements when focus moves.

liam (A11y): prefer staying in the modal. if we navigate away SR users lose context. add aria-live="assertive" on the secret region and on revoke warnings. ensure icon contrast and don't rely on color alone.

nina (PM): product wants quick return to list for multi-key workflows, but copying the new secret is higher priority. propose: stay in-modal, show a primary "Done, return to keys" CTA and a prominent inline helper: "Copy now — you will only see this once."

maria (Design): updated copy suggestion for revoke: "Revoking this key will immediately stop any services using it. This action cannot be undone." increased icon contrast, added bold "immediately" for emphasis.

josh (Eng): implementation notes: to announce revoke, use <div role="alert"> or aria-live="assertive". for the role dropdown, add a small keyboard-focusable info button that opens a persistent tooltip. avoid hover-only interactions.

liam (A11y): tooltip must be accessible via keyboard and linked via aria-describedby when visible. for role selection, add an inline banner when Admin is chosen: "Admin grants full management rights — double-check this role." programmatically connect it so SRs read it on change.

maria (Design): will update mocks: keep modal open after rotate, auto-select secret, add copy helper, accessible revoke alert, info button for Role with short microcopy, inline admin banner. will push PR and share screens. :white_check_mark:

ci-bot: pipeline passed for branch feature/keys-a11y-tweaks (build 2026-11-04T11:05Z).

nina (PM): thanks — let's do a 10-min pairing when PR is up to verify keyboard + SR flow.

josh (Eng): i'll join.

liam (A11y): i'll run the checklist (focus, announcements, tooltip access, contrast).
